FN-WU4BEE9-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 334
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/26/2024
House Bill 334 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Crime Victims
Compensation Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of compensation
paid to human trafficking victims per the provisions of this bill.
This bill would further increase the obligations of the Fund by a commission-estimated $23,000
to $34,000 annually by providing the members of the Alabama Crime Victims Compensation
Commission up to $250 per day, as set by the board, for compensation for performance of their
duties, in addition to their existing per diem for commission meeting attendance.

FN-WU4BEE9-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 334
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/07/2024
House Bill 334 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the obligations of the
Alabama Crime Victims Compensation Fund by a maximum of $5,000 per victim of human
trafficking per the provisions of this bill.
This bill would further increase the obligations of the Fund by a commission-estimated $23,000
to $34,000 annually by providing the members of the Alabama Crime Victims Compensation
Commission up to $250 per day, as set by the board, for compensation for performance of their
duties, in addition to their existing per diem for commission meeting attendance.
